label: For "Provider Data Reconciliation Across Payer Systems": Reconcile provider identity, demographics, specialties, affiliations, contract status and effective dates across payer, credentialing, claims and directory systems, and give data stewards matched records, conflicts, source-of-truth recommendations and a temporal history. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Auto-merging fuzzy matches.
